actor: agent-defined analysis conventions and illustrative scenarios; no human approval or measured savings implied
scenario_volume_basis: 30000 tickets/year from the brief divided by 12; hypothetical context, not an observed period of the CSV

scenario_definitions.eligible_share: assumed fraction eligible for the assistance task
scenario_definitions.assisted_share: assumed usable assistance among eligible cases, not IT classifier coverage
scenario_definitions.assisted_minutes: active handling time excluding the incremental review/rework below
scenario_definitions.review_share: fraction of assisted cases receiving additional human review
scenario_definitions.error_share: fraction of assisted cases requiring additional rework; not a measured model error rate
scenario_definitions.fixed_minutes: recurring preparation/monitoring effort applied even if no case is assisted
scenario_definitions.hourly_value_brl: hypothetical valuation of capacity, not salary evidence, cash savings or financial ROI
